section_summary: This section contains Department of State correspondence, memoranda, and military permit action slips from late December 1949 and early January 1950 relating to entry permits and transit clearances for individuals visiting occupied Japan. Specific matters include travel clearance for commercial entrants David Feldman and Gabriel Josue, transit authorization for Turkish UN delegate Kasim Gulek, and an exploratory trade trip by the Textile Industry Committee on Foreign Trade. The section concludes with an attached May 1945 secret despatch from Sian reporting on the illicit smuggling of mercury into Japanese-occupied China.
